summary: DeepSeek-V4-Pro Max approved the final P5 proof-security candidate with zero blocking findings. It confirmed PS-P5-001 is closed: every required confirmation or counterproof clause must be registered/executable, selected, checked and accepted as verified_true before terminal closure. It also confirmed the final strict boolean validation rejects numeric or string required values before action-catalog construction, including an otherwise correctly re-sealed forged obligation. The reviewer traced the engine, runner, TerminalAuthority, model adapter, SecuritySpec, Hunter, alert-verify, cache epoch, report reuse, Decision Trace and import boundaries and found no model, legacy, compat or malformed-clause path that can close a candidate without program-recomputed Checker authority.

non_blocking_findings.title: Fast profile conservatively projects reverified proof closure as needs-review
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The fast close-without-model helper keeps the public disposition at needs_review even when proof details retain a programmatic confirmed closure.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Document this conservative policy or project the proof disposition consistently in a future change.

non_blocking_findings.title: Per-action V3 diagnostic overwrites the aggregate proof decision field
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The action executor records fact_verified or needs_review in proof_kernel_decision; current root/ref checks make this conservative and prevent terminal upgrade.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Store per-action diagnostics in a separate field and recompute the root when extending artifact references.

non_blocking_findings.title: Alert verification trusts a self-consistent frozen attached proof bundle
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Alert verification replays the attached frozen IR and proof objects but does not re-extract the current alert file to compare its code/backend hashes.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: When indexed source is available, optionally re-extract FunctionIRGraph and require identity with the attached proof IR.

non_blocking_findings.title: Unselected evaluate compatibility entry remains public
non_blocking_findings.evidence: ProofKernelEngine.evaluate executes the complete system catalog and has no current live product caller; live callers use evaluate_selected_actions.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Deprecate the compatibility entry if future consumers do not require it.

non_blocking_findings.title: Non-v3 validation result cacheability check is implicit
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Pre-P5 rows remain unreachable because the cache protocol binds the P5 epoch and legacy payloads cannot close a candidate, but the cacheability predicate does not explicitly reject every non-v3 schema.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Return false explicitly for non-v3 payloads as defense in depth.

non_blocking_findings.title: Localized Hunter coverage reuse is not wired to a persisted structural set
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The current planner may re-hunt structurally unchanged units; the blind projection and registration boundary remain isolated from live candidate or verdict state.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add only structurally derived persisted coverage keys if future efficiency work requires them.

checks.name: PS-P5-001 complete required-clause closure
checks.evidence: _authoritative_closure fails closed when any required clause is outside the catalog, unselected, missing a Checker result, or not accepted/verified_true; unknown counterproof can no longer be treated as absence.

checks.name: strict boolean required validation
checks.evidence: _validate_clause requires isinstance(required, bool), and every engine, checker, provider and Hunter offer ingestion validates the obligation before use.

checks.name: symmetric malformed-field and partial-action bypass audit
checks.evidence: No other clause required truthiness consumer exists; optional-only, partial action, unsupported predicate, incomplete coverage and Java paths remain needs_review.

checks.name: TerminalAuthority v3 sole origin
checks.evidence: Confirmed and rejected_with_proof require recomputed Checker refs, non-empty artifact refs, matching proof root, verified integrity and a proof-checker authority identity.

checks.name: bounded model adapter
checks.evidence: The Proof Engine agent exposes only frozen action IDs; facts, predicates, parameters, coverage and terminal disposition are program-owned and legacy Validator v2 inputs are rejected.

checks.name: entry binding and guard semantics
checks.evidence: Entry parameter binding validates count, slot, identity and full signature domain; guard dominance remains a CFG fact and cannot stand in for value-range counterproof.

checks.name: SecuritySpec freshness and qualification
checks.evidence: Only the highest fresh qualification-backed stable revision compiles; stale dependencies, conflicts, unresolved evidence and revision hash drift fail closed.

checks.name: Hunter live isolation and fast/alert policy
checks.evidence: Hunter registration is force-unconfirmed and candidate-registration-only; fast and alert-verify do not invoke Hunter or a model.

checks.name: post-closure and single-terminal invariants
checks.evidence: Programmatic closure stops later model/tool iterations, conflicts are program-resolved, and Decision Trace rejects a second differing terminal event for the cluster.

checks.name: cache, compat and legacy isolation
checks.evidence: The P5 cache epoch and RuntimeAuthorityManifest gate reuse; compat is read-only, removed agents are absent, and legacy proof fields cannot create evidence or terminal state.

checks.name: wheel and recorded gates
checks.evidence: The reviewer accepted the recorded candidate wheel SHA-256 bd851f86fb66a4ed6920ec76b321733fc6767eb91e4a8f00c7a6afc13a48de67 and final local result of 1819 passed and 7 skipped without independently rebuilding or rerunning them.

limitations: The review was static and read-only; it did not run tests, unpack the wheel or execute a scan.
The three historical P0 aggregate artifacts are absent and were not replayed.
Dynamic exploit attempts were not executed; adversarial paths were traced from source and tests.
Alert verification accepts a self-consistent frozen attached proof bundle without source re-extraction, as recorded in NB-03.
No Range truth, fixture, expected finding, ground truth or Scorer input was read, and no external-model benchmark was run.
attestation: DeepSeek-V4-Pro Max, running in DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 with reasoning_effort=max and permission_mode=read-only, personally reviewed exact clean commit 1797389af9807c74c1261f1ad85a3a18b17c23e2 and tree 325b3c6a6cf7caf85200088af1a17324adafeb5d. It used no subagents, made no file or Git changes, accessed no credentials, read no Range truth/fixture/Scorer input and ran no external-model benchmark. Decision: approved with zero blocking findings.
